sources.title: grounding-dino-base: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: The model combines a vision encoder and text encoder within the transformer architecture, extending DINO with grounded pre-training for open-set object detection. The base variant processes images of variable resolution (no specific maximum specified) and text queries consisting of lowercased object descriptions ending with periods.

sources.title: Grounding DINO · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Grounding DINO extends a closed-set object detection model with a text encoder, enabling open-set object detection. The model achieves remarkable results, such as 52.5 AP on COCO zero-shot. The abstract from the paper is the following:

sources.title: Grounding DINO - High Accuracy AI Object Recognition System
sources.snippet: Grounding DINO is a vision-language AI model that enables open-vocabulary object detection with precise text-based recognition & localization capabilities.
